results.name: Agents Helping Agents Club
results.description: A monthly gathering for real estate agents hosted by a brokerage at its Asheville office.
results.notes: Brokerage-hosted agents-only meetup; business development programming; only two listings.

results.name: Artemis Adventure Club
results.description: A social outdoor group that organizes easy hikes, garden walks, paddles, camping weekends and game nights around Asheville.
results.notes: Run by Artemis Rising Collective (wellness/yoga events); no own site found. Regular social outings.

results.name: Asheville Astrology Club
results.description: A social and discussion group for astrology enthusiasts, with roundtables, astro-weather chats, plant walks and bar socials.
results.notes: Meetup events only; distinct from the Weaverville Astrology Club (c:astrology-club).

results.name: Asheville Business Strategy Meetup Group
results.description: A lunch for founders and small-business owners to talk about what is working in their businesses.
results.notes: Business-owner networking lunch; business-development programming; only two events.

results.name: Asheville Diners Club (25-45)
results.description: A social group for adults roughly 25 to 45 that meets for group dinners at a different Asheville restaurant each time.
results.notes: Meetup only; recurring organizer and age-based social identity. Last event early Sept 2026.

results.name: Asheville Health + Wellness Networking
results.description: A monthly networking meetup for health and wellness practitioners to build referral networks.
results.notes: Practitioner networking to grow practices and referrals; business-development programming.

results.name: Asheville Monday Night Contra Dance
results.description: A weekly contra dance with a beginner lesson, a live band and a caller. Open to everyone, with a sober, welcoming dance community.
results.notes: Listed by CDSS and Old Farmers Ball contra pages; own site not confirmed. Dance community of regulars.

results.name: Asheville Retro Video Gaming Meetup Group
results.description: A casual meetup for fans of classic video games to play retro consoles together and swap controllers.
results.notes: Meetup with only one event (Mar 2026); kept as grey.

results.name: Asheville Stitchers
results.description: A monthly stitch night where knitters, crocheters and other crafters bring portable projects and work together at a brewery.
results.notes: Meetup; consistent monthly meetings at New Belgium, last Sept 2026.

results.name: Asheville Young Professionals (AYPROS)
results.description: A social and civic group for young professionals in their 20s and 30s with pub clubs, volunteer days, outdoor meetups and civic programs.
results.notes: Search confirms AYPROS (ages 18-40) with events.aypros.org and Instagram @aypros828; separate from Chamber PROpel AVL.

results.name: AVL Writers
results.description: A peer critique and writing group where writers bring printed pages for feedback, plus write-a-thons and quiet writing sessions.
results.notes: Meetup group (formerly Asheville Writers); weekly critique at Westville Pub.

results.name: Blooms of Kindness
results.description: A volunteer program that delivers recycled flower arrangements to people in local healthcare facilities. Volunteers register for shifts.
results.notes: Run by AmeriHealth Caritas NC wellness center; corporate-sponsored but volunteers return. Grey, kept.

results.name: Carolina Resource Center for Eating Disorders Support Group
results.description: A free online peer-led support group for people recovering from eating disorders, facilitated by licensed therapists and dietitians.
results.notes: Weekly online meetings per Mountain Xpress listings; last July 2026. Site not verified.

results.name: Community Kirtan and Song Circle
results.description: A call-and-response devotional chanting and singing circle where participants join in or listen.
results.notes: Many listings through Dec 2026 at The Well; website is the venue site (only page found).

results.name: Dating for Love: Mindful Modern Relationships
results.description: Structured mini-date evenings for singles led by a relationship coach.
results.notes: Events are registration-based programs presented by Dr. Deb Barnett (coach); a business, not a member group.

results.name: Eda's Bluegrass Jam
results.description: An open weekly bluegrass jam where pickers of any level trade breaks and play traditional tunes. Listeners are welcome.
results.notes: Matches approved sibling bluegrass jams; weekly regulars. Site not found.

results.name: Ferguson Family YMCA Crafting Club
results.description: A free monthly gathering where crafters of all ages and skill levels bring projects to work on and share techniques.
results.notes: YMCA WNC listings; last Mar 2026. Separate from Asheville YMCA Crafting Club (different branch).

results.name: Garden Club of Weaverville
results.description: A co-ed nonprofit garden club open to everyone, with monthly meetings, native plant talks and an annual plant and seed exchange.
results.notes: Confirmed via search: club site gardenclubofweaverville.org and Biltmore Beacon coverage.

results.name: Highland Brewing Pick-Up Volleyball
results.description: Drop-in pickup volleyball on the brewery meadow courts for players of all skill levels, rotating into games.
results.notes: Grey: drop-in with a $5 wristband, but regulars return. Separate from the Highland volleyball league.

results.name: Intuition & Mediumship Practice Circle
results.description: A supportive practice circle for people of all experience levels to develop intuition and mediumship skills through exercises and practice readings.
results.notes: Listings Feb-Apr 2026 at The Well; none since.

results.name: Keep Asheville Crafty
results.description: An open craft night with supplies provided, held on Monday evenings at a local brewery taproom.
results.notes: Listed under Meetup Mondays at Archetype; last seen Feb 2026. No site found.

results.name: Liberty Bicycles Slow-cial MTB Ride
results.description: A social, no-drop mountain bike ride with conversational breaks, starting from the Ledford trailhead in Bent Creek.
results.notes: Standing shop-hosted ride with regulars, upcoming dates listed by Asheville on Bikes.

results.name: Meditation for Community Healers
results.description: A weekly donation-based meditation and silence circle for care professionals such as therapists, bodyworkers and spiritual teachers.
results.notes: Peer respite circle for a shared professional identity; last listing June 2026. No own site found.

results.name: Milonga Del Barrio
results.description: An Argentine tango social dance held on fourth Sunday afternoons, welcoming dancers in a respectful, inclusive space.
results.notes: Only two listings (Jan, Apr 2026) via Facebook events.

results.name: NCIW Wellness Book Club
results.description: A book club that reads and discusses health and wellness titles, sometimes with a guest expert. Free and open to all.
results.notes: Meetup; hosted by an integrative wellness clinic but free book club with returning readers.

results.name: Old Time Mountain Music Acoustic Jam
results.description: A weekly old-time Appalachian acoustic jam where pickers and listeners gather, with tips supporting Transylvania Junior Appalachian Musicians.
results.notes: Weekly jam with upcoming dates at 185 King Street (listings via venue and Mountain Xpress).

results.name: Pilates & Prayer
results.description: A free Christian-focused womens Pilates mat class combining fitness, prayer and community, highlighting a local charity each month.
results.notes: Town of Weaverville listings May-Jul 2026; faith-based women community.

results.name: Recess for Active Retirees (RFAR)
results.description: A social group for active retirees that organizes walks, garden visits, festivals and tours around Asheville.
results.notes: Meetup with 40+ events; age-based social group.

results.name: SeekHealing BLIPOC Support Group
results.description: A free monthly support group for Black, Latinx, Indigenous and People of Color focused on belonging, healing and resilience.
results.notes: Confirmed via search; program of SeekHealing (c:seekhealing is the umbrella org), kept as its own group.

results.name: Skinny Beats Sound Meditation
results.description: Paid weekend sound meditation sessions led by one practitioner at a drum shop.
results.notes: Ticketed $30 sessions led by shop practitioner; storefront for paid sessions, no member community.

results.name: Staying Grounded in Shaky Times
results.description: A spiritual practice and peer support group for seekers, exploring meditation, breathwork and meditative movement with discussion.
results.notes: Weekly Dec 2025-Apr 2026 at a health plan wellness center; no listings since.

results.name: Swing Asheville
results.description: A swing dance community offering beginner-friendly Monday night classes with no partner needed.
results.notes: Grey: paid class series but a dance community; only Jan 2026 Facebook events. Separate from Asheville Swing Night.

results.name: The Rise Above Community
results.description: A free, traveler-led online peer support group for LGBTQ+ people, including those working through religious trauma.
results.notes: Program of Flaming for Jesus per search results; upcoming weekly sessions through Dec 2026.

results.name: Ukulele Circle
results.description: A beginner-friendly monthly ukulele play-along at the library, with a theme each month. Ukuleles can be borrowed.
results.notes: Library program with returning players; monthly with upcoming dates.

results.name: Weaverville Library Teen Dungeons & Dragons
results.description: A library-run Dungeons & Dragons program for tweens and teens ages 12 to 18, open to all skill levels.
results.notes: Matches approved sibling library teen D&D groups; only Dec 2025 listings, so dormant.

results.name: Wild Woman Project
results.description: A monthly circle for women using story, music, meditation, journaling and ritual with a nature-based theme. All faiths are welcome.
results.notes: Circles at The Well Jan-May 2026; website is the venue page.

results.name: WNC Workers Assembly
results.description: A monthly gathering for workers to build skills, discuss workplace issues and organize across industries.
results.notes: Program of Just Economics; upcoming monthly meetings.
